newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 556 bln lire of Italy 3-yr Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 556 bln lire of Italy 3-yr Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 556 billion lire of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 300 billion lire of paper.
They also bid for 560 billion lire of five year Btps against the Treasury's offer of 250 billion.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 5.038 trillion lire at the open auction for the January 1, 2000 paper, against three trillion lire worth of Btps on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.75 from 100.30 at the previous Btp sale in mid-January.
